params.name: datastore-type
params.description: The type of data to catalog (TIMESERIES, LOCATIONS, RATINGS, etc.)

params.name: page
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

params.name: page-size
params.description: Number of results to return per page (max 500)

params.name: office
params.description: Three-character USACE district office code (e.g., SWT, LRN)

params.name: like
params.description: Filter results using a CWMS wildcard pattern

items.docs: Returns a catalog of available time series, locations, or other data stored in CWMS. Use this endpoint to discover available data.
